title: Python: Cookie Attribute Injection via Unescaped Semicolons in http.cookies.Morsel (CVE-2026-16052)
description: A vulnerability in Python's http.cookies.Morsel class allows unescaped semicolons in cookie attribute values, which are included verbatim in output. This can enable an attacker controlling these values to bypass cookie Domain or SameSite restrictions. The issue affects Python versions prior to 3.16.0 and has been fixed in version 3.16.0. The severity is considered low.
